versions.changelog:
Article Formatter - Version 1.0.0

- Initial release with comprehensive documentation in SKILL.md
- Defines core capabilities: article structure optimization, visual enhancement with emoji/icons, info presentation (tables, lists, quotes), and CTA best practices
- Includes detailed formatting rules for different article types (tutorial, opinion, review, etc.)
- Mobile-friendly layout guidelines and color system provided
- Quality checklist and workflow documented for effective use and consistent output
